beginner.summary: For developers who can write Python or JavaScript and are new to the OpenAI platform. Covers projects and API keys, the Python and JavaScript SDKs, the Responses API and Chat Completions, sampling and token budgets, model choice, streaming, errors, rate limits and cost, prompt patterns, Structured Outputs with Pydantic and Zod, a first function tool, vision inputs, the Moderation API and key hygiene, ending in a command-line support assistant.
prerequisites: Writes working Python or JavaScript programs and installs packages with pip or npm
Understands HTTP requests, JSON and status codes
Has an OpenAI Platform account with a small prepaid balance and a terminal with curl and jq
outcomes: Call the Responses API and Chat Completions from SDKs and raw HTTP and read every part of the response
Control cost, latency and reliability with token budgets, streaming, retries and rate-limit headers
Produce validated typed output with Structured Outputs and run a single function tool
Build and test a small command-line tool that moderates input, handles errors and reports cost

advanced.summary: For engineers who own OpenAI-backed systems in production. Covers Realtime voice sessions over WebSocket and WebRTC, the Agents SDK with handoffs, guardrails, sessions and tracing, the Evals API and CI gates, supervised, preference and reinforcement fine-tuning, distillation, cost and latency engineering, rate-limit management, Azure OpenAI differences and Entra ID authentication, data retention and compliance, safety architecture, observability and model migration, ending in a production agent service.

Can write CI pipelines and read metrics dashboards
Understands IAM, secrets management and basic network security
outcomes: Build voice and multi-agent applications with the Realtime API and Agents SDK
Gate quality with Evals, fine-tuning and distillation backed by measured results
Engineer cost, latency and rate-limit behaviour with load tests and dashboards
Operate securely on OpenAI and Azure OpenAI with retention, safety and migration controls
